[**Work in progress**]{.status-tag} · 2026

## \> *We propose a theoretical framework unifying the narratives of fertility trends into a single model with two successive innovation–diffusion processes: the spread of lower fertility (quantum) and delayed fertility (tempo). Tested on French regional data 1855–2023.*
